rationale: A holds a near-empty preloader for over 2 s (still showing on the mobile first viewport), and even after the entrance its hero headline sits half-masked behind the tree silhouettes; project illustrations also show stray black bars and several scroll frames are mostly blank or faded mid-reveal. B builds its hero within ~1.3 s with a staggered headline and a tree-ring drawing itself, then carries a pinned process sequence where the timber frame assembles step by step, all in a cohesive warm-paper/forest palette. B's hovers (colour-shifting lifted pills, underlines, card lift) are crisp, whereas A's custom cursor blob obscures labels. B's phone layout is clean and fully populated.
